Commentary.Commentary: Earlier, the top order of the hosts flourished, providing a good foundation to the middle order. However, Sri Lanka clawed back into the contest through some terrific bowling from Herath and Lakmal. The veteran took his 32nd fifer in Test cricket. However, the debutant, Sohail was the major reason that the home side finished on a high. This game seems to be heading towards a draw but stranger things have happened in cricket. Will we see a collapse or will the Lankan batsmen grind in? Join us for the evening session in a while...

So, early Tea has been taken! Haris Sohail, take a bow! What a brilliant knock in a pressure situation. He didn't let the Sri Lankan spinners settle down and scored a brilliant 76 on his Test debut. He shepherded the lower order smartly, what composure on returning to international cricket after such a long time! To add to that, the flourish from Hasan Ali and the defiance from Mohammad Abbas has helped Pakistan to go past the visitors' total, thereby taking a 3-run lead which at one stage looked highly unlikely.

OUT! The new ball does the trick for Sri Lanka! Pradeep comes steaming in and hurls a fuller length delivery on off, Sohail tires to give it a thwack but gets it off the toe-end of the bat. The ball balloons towards mid on where Lakmal takes a good reverse cup catch over his head. Haris can't believe this and eventually trudges off. Pakistan are bowled out for 422, lead by 3 runs!
Marginally ahead of a length on off, Haris leans forward to keep that one.
Fuller in length and around off, driven straight to mid off for nothing.
Second new ball is available now and Sri Lanka have taken it straightaway. Nuwan Pradeep to have a go with it first...
Fullish delivery, Mohammad successfully blocks it. Good composure shown by the No. 11.
Strides forward to the tossed up delivery and blocks it.
Quicker through the air, kept out off the back foot.
Slow through the air on middle, defended watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker one outside off, pushed to covers.
Herath is back on.
More runs! Floats it up wider outside off, Sohail slices the drive over cover-point and collects tow more to his tally. Shoulders in the Lankan camp have started drooping.
FOUR! Pakistan take the lead now! Drops it short and bowls it outside off, Sohail goes back and cracks it through cover to find the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball outside off, pushed towards the point fielder.
Fuller and on the stumps, blocked.
Bye! Darts it on leg, Abbas misses his flick and so does Dickwella. They steal a leg bye.
A lot of talk going on between the Sri Lankan players. Terrific batting from Pakistan has certainly put the visitors in a bit of bother.
FOUR! Good shot! Sohail moves down the track, adjusts well and drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary. He's playing it so well at the moment. Deserves a century here.
Sees the batsman coming down and hence fires it wide outside off, Sohail slices it towards cover-point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated ball around off, Haris blocks it into the ground.
Slider around middle, Haris leans forward in defense.
Floated delivery around middle and off, Sohail defends it off the front foot.
Perera is back on.
Goes around the wicket and bowls a loopy ball, dipping in, Abbas defends it down nicely.
Flighted delivery around middle and off, Sohail plays a controlled chip shot down the ground for a single. Can Abbas survive one ball?
Wide! Bowls a googly but loses the radar. Slips it miles down the leg side, Dickwella moves to his right to stop it.
On middle and leg, blocked into the ground.
In the air... safe! Tosses it up around off, it turns away a touch, Sohail comes down the track to go big but ends up slicing it towards long off. Luckily, it falls well short of the man coming in.
Gives it loop, bowls it wide outside off, Haris doesn't play at it.
Floats it up around off, Sohail defends it from within the crease.
Switches to round the wicket and bangs in a short ball on leg, Mohammad Abbas once again ducks under it.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Abbas calmly sits under it.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery on off, pushed towards mid off for nothing.
Back of a length delivery outside off, pushed off the back foot to the off side.
Short delivery around off, Abbas ducks under it.
Comes down the track and drives it straight towards the extra cover fielder.

Sandakan gives it a truck loaded with flight, Sohail goes fishing after it as he looks to go big over covers. However, the ball turns away, just past the off stump and deflects off Dickwella's pads towards short third man.
Around middle and leg, pushed towards the mid on fielder.
Slower through the air, near the off stump, defended by coming forward.
Another one turning away from off, Haris makes another leave.
Good leave! Sandakan tosses it up around off, it turns away, Sohail lunges forward and makes a leave.
Lakshan Sandakan is back into the attack.
Spears in a perfect yorker at the base of middle stump, Abbas does well to bring his bat down in time to dig it out.
Angles in a fuller length delivery from outside off, Mohammad gets forward and keeps it out.
Short leg in place for Abbas...
Good length delivery outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Offers some width and bowls it outside off, HS cuts it square of the wicket on the off side where the point fielder is quick to stop that one.
Drops it on a length on off, it triggers back in a bit, Haris is right behind the line to keep it out.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Sohail has got nothing to do with that one.
Suranga Lakmal is back on.
Abbas has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, defended off the front foot gently.

NOT OUT! Clipping the leg stump! The on-field call stays! Herath bowls a slider around middle and it beats the front foot defense of Abbas to ping him on the pads. Loud appeal from the Lankans but umpire Nigel Llong stays put. He reckons it is going down leg. Chandimal takes the review and replays show it would have clipped the leg pole. Sri Lanka don't waste a review!
Sri Lanka have taken an LBW review against Abbas. Is it going down leg? Let's wait and find out..
Flattish ball around middle and off, Abbas defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller and darting in on the stumps, defended by getting right behind the line.
Floats it up outside off, turns further away, Abbas just lets it be.

Drinks taken. Haris Sohail has been brilliant on his Test debut. He has taken the attack to the opposition whenever required and has shepherded the lower order really well. His calmness and confidence has impressed one and all. The trail for Pakistan is down to only 11 now. Good fightback from them!

SIX! What a hit! He is so assured when he uses his feet. Sohail dances down the track to the tossed up delivery outside off and lifts it over long off to clear the fence with ease. Haris continues to go strong.
Uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and eases it to the bowler.
Waits for this one to come to him and plays it with soft hands to mid on.
Down the leg side, Haris tries to flick it but misses.
Shorter in length, tapped to backward point.
Floated in line of the stumps, defended solidly.
Fullish delivery, kept out watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slider on middle and leg, goes past Abbas' defence to rap him on the pads. Stifled appeal for an LBW turned down.

Not Out! Tossed up around off, Abbas tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs towards Kaushal Silva at silly point who takes it sharply. The Sri Lankans feel that it has carried on the full and appeal. The umpires chat with each other and take it upstairs. The replays show that it was clearly a bump ball.
The umpires refer a bat-pad decision upstairs. The soft signal is not out.
Coming in with the arm, Abbas prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge on his pads. Dickwella appeals loudly but there was wood involved.
Short delivery outside off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Loopy ball around middle and off, defended by showing the full face of the bat.

FOUR! That's blazed! Tossed up ball outside off, Haris Sohail dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drills it between mid off and extra cover. Pierces the gap and picks up a boundary. 400 up for Pakistan now!
Tries to come forward but then after seeing the turn, he goes back and defends it off the back foot.
A bit flatter through the air, turning away from middle, Haris stays back in defense.
Floats it up on the stumps, it's dug out by the batsman.
Drops it short from around the wicket, Sohail goes back and punches it towards sweeper cover.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl now.
On a length on off, pushed back to the bowler.

No ball! Alas, Pradeep again oversteps. Full delivery outside off, Haris gets it off the outer half to backward point and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been close.
In the air... but safe! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Sohail mistimes his pull over mid on and the ball falls down safely. Two runs taken.
Short delivery on leg, Haris ducks under it.
Full delivery outside off, glided to third man for a run.
Shortish delivery, pulled awkwardly to fine leg for a run.
No ball! Back of a length delivery, kept out off the back foot. Pradeep has overstepped again. His worry continues.
Shortish outside off, Abbas rides the bounce and taps it to covers.
Dropped! Sohail takes it on the full and drives it straight to Herath. The veteran kneels, gets his hands to it but fails to hold on. He is disappointed.
Tossed up delivery, Sohail lunges forward in defense.
Floated delivery, defended off the front foot.
Quicker one, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Sohail defends it nicely.
Yorker on off, Abbas does well to block it.
No ball! Back of a length delivery, Abbas keeps it out. Oh no, Pradeep has overstepped again.
Similar length delivery outside off, played with an angled blade to point for a run.
Length ball outside off, patted to covers.
Fullish delivery outside off, Sohail goes for a drive but gets it off the outer half to backward point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Mohammad Abbas is the last man in! Also, Nuwan Pradeep is back into the attack.

OUT! 32nd Test 5-fer for Rangana Herath! The veteran is an artist at work and he comes back in style. He sees Hasan coming down the track and hence, bowls it slower through the air on middle. Ali is deceived in the flight as the ball spins away past the outside edge of his bat and Dickwella behind the stumps does the rest. A breezy knock from the Pakistani comes to an end. The hosts trail by 29 runs.

SIX! Ali is playing a very crucial knock for Pakistan! He along with Sohail are bringing down the deficit. Floated outside off, Hasan clears his front leg and smokes it over long on for a huge maximum.
Takes a couple of steps down the track and pats it back to the bowler.
SIX! Bang! Tossed up delivery, Ali slog sweeps it over cow corner and the ball sails over the fence.

Test fifty on debut for Haris Sohail! for On the pads, Sohail helps it to fine leg for a run. He raises his bat towards the Pakistani dressing room. Azhar Ali and Sarfraz Ahmed are up on their feet to acknowledge him. A patient and composed knock from Haris. He didn't play first-class cricket for almost three years and when he was selected in the side, the decision was criticized severely. That's some way to silence the critics!
Fullish on middle, eased back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Ali paddle sweeps it through short fine leg. Herath chases it and slides near the fence to make a good stop. Saves a couple for his side. Commitment at its best!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Camps back to the shortish delivery and punches it down to long on for a run.
Strides forward to defend it confidently.
Very full outside off, Haris goes for an expansive drive but gets it off the bottom half to first slip.
FOUR! Sohail is batting with a lot of confidence! Short and spinning away. Sohail rocks back and cuts it behind point to find the fence.
Fullish around off, eased to covers.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.

SIX! Great counter-attacking cricket from Hasan Ali! Gets this in the slot and swings his arms freely. Has hit it clean as a whistle down the ground for a huge biggie. He is taking the veteran on with a lot of confidence.
FOUR! Handy runs! Tossed up delivery on middle, Ali with a high backlift plays an agricultural slog past mid on for a boundary.
A bit quicker on off, pushed off the front foot to short cover.
Floated on off, patted back to Herath.
Floated outside off, eased to covers.
Two fielders in the mid-wicket region now.
Slow through the air down the leg side, Haris fails to clip it through.
Fullish on off, Sohail lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up around off, Hasan slog sweeps it to deep mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Floated outside off, pushed with an open bat face to point.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Half-tracker on off, Ali camps back and flat-bats it past mid off for a rocketing boundary. He is off the mark with that.
Lakshan Sandakan is brought into the attack.
Full delivery outside off, kept out watchfully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good comeback from Herath. Bowls the slider outside off. Sohail fails to pick it up and gets beaten.

SIX! Boom! This is the reason he denied the single on the last delivery. Uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and tonks it with authority over long on for a maximum. Sarfraz in the dressing room likes it. 350 comes up for Pakistan!
Short outside off, staying low. Sohail cuts it nicely to deepish point. Denies the run this time.
Slow through the air outside off, patted towards mid off.
Pradeep goes wider of the crease and bowls a fullish delivery on off. Eased to mid off.
Ali rides the bounce to the back of a length delivery and tucks it to mid-wicket.
No ball! Short of a length delivery around off, punched off the back foot to cover-point. Pradeep has overstepped once again. The replays show that it was a tight call.
Bouncer outside off, Hasan drops his wrists and lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off, Ali hangs back and defends it solidly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, guided smartly past the diving gully fielder to rotate strike.
Short delivery wide outside off, Sohail doesn't bother to play at that one.
Fullish on off, Sohail milks it down to long on for a run and will retain the strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Strides forward to the flighted delivery and blocks it again.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and punches it to covers.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up outside off, Sohail is nimble on his feet and creams it through the gap between mid off and extra cover to pick up a boundary.
Rangana Herath to bowl from the other end.
Very full delivery attacking the off stump, Hasan is alert to it as he digs it out back to Pradeep.
Length delivery outside off, stays low. Ali feels for it but misses.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Hasan ducks under it.
Fuller length delivery outside off, swinging in. Ali hangs back and tries to block it but is beaten all ends up. Dickwella dives to his left and takes it nicely.
No ball! Back of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to covers. Pradeep has overstepped on this occasion.
Short and width on offer, Haris cuts it behind point to rotate strike.
Length delivery outside off, Sohail plants his front foot across to let it go.
We are back for the afternoon session. Haris Sohail to continue his innings while Hasan Ali joins him at the crease. Nuwan Pradeep to bowl first up after lunch. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

The hosts still trail by 79 runs with only two wickets in hand. The tourists will look to come out after lunch and wrap the tail up in a jiffy. The cracks are opening up a bit but nothing significant. The batsmen can score runs if they apply themselves. Can Pakistan wipe off the deficit? Join us in a while for the afternoon session.

A brilliant session for Sri Lanka. They have picked up four wickets and gave away only 74 runs in 27.4 overs. The visitors came out with intent and bowled probing lines and lengths, especially Herath and Lakmal. The experienced campaigner got the big wicket of Azhar Ali and after that, wickets kept falling at regular intervals.

OUT! Yasir Shah departs on the final ball before lunch! 4-fer for Rangana Herath! He bowls a loopy delivery outside off, Shah leans forward to flick it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge and the ball lobs towards Thirimanne at first slip who makes no mistake. Sri Lanka are pumped! LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Loopy delivery outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Darts it full on the stumps, blocked watchfully.
An appeal for LBW! Slider around leg, forced Shah to go back and play. He does so but misses and is hit on the pads. Dickwella appeals loud and hard but to no avail.
Lunges forward and blocks it out gently into the ground.
Beaten! That was a good ball. Herath tosses it up on off, Shah lunges forward to defend but the ball turns away to nearly take the outside edge of the bat of Yasir.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Sohail goes back to cut but chops it towards the point fielder.
Once again bowls a googly, Sohail fails to read it and wears it on the pads.
Googly outside off, Shah goes back and then steers it away towards short third man for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven towards cover for a single.
Flatter and quicker through the air outside off, left alone by Haris.
Floats it up on the stumps, pushed off the front foot towards the cover region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Chance! Floats it up on the stumps, Shah comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball just lobs wide of the short leg fielder.
From around the wicket to the right-hander, Yasir comes forward to defend but the ball turns away and nearly takes the outside edge.
Drops it a bit short outside off, placed towards the backward point fielder for one.
Flighted delivery on off, defended off the front foot gently.
Flatter through the air outside off, turning back in, Sohail chops it away towards the off side.
Herath is back on.
Flatter ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Floats it up on the stumps, worked towards mid on.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Shah dabs it with an open bat face behind point for a single.
Keeps it full on the stumps, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Sohail decides to leave it alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Once again hits the deck hard but not enough pace and bounce to trouble the tailender. Yasir ducks.
Short of a length delivery on off, Yasir quickly evades it by moving away.
Hurls it on a fuller length and it holds its line, the Pakistan leggie decides to flirt with it and hence gets beaten all ends up.
Once again goes full but overpitches it by a margin. Yasir Shah leans ahead for a drive but gets it off the outer half behind point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Beautiful from Yasir! Lakmal fires in a full ball on middle, Shah leans forward and with a full face of the bat, eases it past a diving Sandakan at mid on for a boundary.
Leans forward and blocks it out watchfully.

NOT OUT! But a good throw from Lakmal! Sohail tucks it towards fine leg and calls for two. Lakmal fires a throw from the deep towards the keeper who takes the bails off as Haris drags his bat in. They appeal and it is taken upstairs. Replays show the batsman is safely in. Two added to the total.
There is a run out appeal at the striker's end. Seems safe though.
Lots of flight from Sandakan, Sohail shoulders his arms to that one.
Bowls a googly this time, but it's down leg. Haris lets it be.
Very full outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Flatter through the air and bowls it outside off, Sohail shoulders his arms to that one.
Fullish in line of the stumps, kept out watchfully. Great over from Lakmal.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Yasir Shah is the next man in.

OUT! Lakmal gets his second wicket! He has bowled his heart out and is reaping the rewards. Length delivery on off, swings in a touch. Amir prods forward tentatively to block it but misses to get rapped on the front pad. Lakmal roars in appeal and up goes Richard Kettleborough's finger. Amir is not confident but after talking to his partner, challenges the decision. The replays roll in. It is pitching in line, impact is in line and it is going to clip the top of the off stump. Good passage of play for the visitors. Pakistan don't lose a review as it just clipped the stumps and hence, the on-field decision stays.
Mohammad Amir after having a conversation with Sohail, opts for the review. It is really close to the naked eye.
Tucks Sohail with a shortish delivery on the hips. He hops and rides the bounce nicely. Gets it around the corner for a run.
Length delivery this time in the same channel. Haris pushes it off the back foot to covers.
Fullish delivery around off, Sohail strides forward to block it.
Bowls the wrong one and bowls it a bit too full on the stumps, the batsman easily digs it out.
Gives it a nice flight and bowls it outside off, Amir leaves it alone.
Drops it on a shorter length on middle, punched towards cover.
Lunges forward and defends it down gently.
Flatter on the stumps, whipped away through mid-wicket for three runs.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Sohail doesn't play at it.
Lakshan Sandakan is brought into the attack.
Lakmal goes around the wicket and fires in a yorker on the stumps, Mohammad jams it out.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Amir ducks under it to evade it.
Amir gets behind the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller and sprayed a touch wider outside off, left alone by the Pakistan pacer.
On a length and outside off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed with an angled bat towards gully. Amir shouts NO! Immediately to send his partner back.
Quicker one around middle and leg, clipped behind square on the leg side and comes back for a couple of runs.
Sohail presses forward and blocks it out gently.

Edged and away! Gives it a bit more air and lands it full outside off, Amir lunges forward to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes past the first slip fielder. The man there chases it down but the batsmen pick up three by then.
Flatter through the air on off, defended by covering the line.
Quicker one on the stumps, kept out with a solid defense.
Tossed up outside off, defended by lunging forward.
Short and on leg, helped by hopping in the crease down to fine leg for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Once again bowls it on a length outside off, Amir has a tentative poke at it inside the line and as a result gets beaten.
Slants it away on a length outside off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Mohammad Amir is the next man in.

OUT! Dragged on! Suranga Lakmal gets the Pakistan skipper! He tries to hit the deck hard and bowls it well outside off. Sarfraz stays back and tries to fetch it from outside off with a pull shot and that proves to be his undoing. Gets an inside edge as the ball then bounces and disturbs the furniture behind. It's a big wicket for Sri Lanka. The hosts still trail by 103 runs.
Short and angling in from outside off, Ahmed winds up for a pull shot but the ball stays a touch low and hits him on the pads.
Looped up outside off, driven back to the bowler. Another maiden for Rangana!
Floats it up outside off, worked towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards the on side.
Outside off, worked with the spin towards mid-wicket.
A bit short and served outside off, slapped towards the man at point.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Sohail bunts it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length outside off, Sarfraz eases it to covers.
Wide! Lakmal bowls a bouncer on middle and leg, Ahmed sits underneath the bumper. Signaled wide by the umpire due to the height.
Short and width on offer, Ahmed cuts it straight to the man at point. Failed to capitalize there.
Fullish delivery outside off, Sarfraz knocks it to short cover.
Angling into Ahmed. He covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ahmed crouches and guides it nicely past backward point for a couple.
Good length delivery on off, Ahmed looks to open up the off side but gets it off the inner half down the track.
Drinks taken. Meanwhile, Suranga Lakmal is back on.
Quicker one, pushed back to the bowler.
Again uses the depth of the crease to guide it to backward point.
Camps back to the shorter delivery and places it to point.
Floated outside off, Ahmed knocks it to sweeper cover for a run.
Full delivery on off, paddle swept to fine leg for a couple.
Quicker delivery on off, Sohail looks to defend it but gets an inside edge past short leg for a run.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.

SIX! What a hit! Sarfraz plays this way and this can work in favour of the hosts. Tossed up outside off, Ahmed has his dancing shoes on and lifts it confidently with the spin over long on for a maximum. Good intent from the Pakistan skipper.
FOUR! Elegant! Tossed up outside off, Ahmed leans ahead and strokes it exquisitely through extra cover for a majestic boundary.
Well bowled! Floated delivery on leg stump, spinning away. Sohail pushes at it tentatively but gets an outside edge past first slip. A run taken.
Quicker ball, Ahmed is nimble on his feet and wrists it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Fullish delivery, Ahmed lunges forward in defense.
Darts it on middle and leg, jammed out towards mid on for nothing.
Once again goes on the back foot and deals with this flatter delivery.
Flatter one around off, turning in, Haris defends it off the back foot.
Sarfraz gets down and fetches the sweep from outside off to backward square leg for a single.
Lunges forward to a loopy ball and blocks it into the ground.
Tosses up ball outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Uses his feet and turns it through mid-wicket for a run and gets off the mark.
Sarfraz dances down the track and defends it to mid on.
Ahmed comes forward and block this one.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Plays this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
The skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed comes out to bat.

OUT! Rangana Herath strikes! The go-to-man has done the trick for Sri Lanka! He tosses this one up on middle, Ali skips down the track but is deceived in the flight. Ends up going through with his clip but is not in control of the stroke. The ball flies uppishly towards the substitute fielder, Sadeera Samarawickrama at short mid-wicket. He dives full length to his left and takes a brilliant catch inches above the ground. Azhar Ali departs after a fabulous knock. He thuds his bat on the pad in disappointment. Deserved a century the way he played. Pakistan trail by 125 runs with half their side back in the hut. Can Sri Lanka trigger a collapse now?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quicker on a fullish length on off, Sohail prods at it tentatively but gets it off the inner half past short leg. A run taken.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Sohail covers his stumps to allow it through.
Floated outside off, Sohail comes down the track and hammers it towards mid off who gets behind it to stop it. The fielder looked clumsy but he got the job done.
Outside off, spinning in. Sohail lets it go.
Sri Lanka's trump card, Rangana Herath comes into the attack.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Uses his feet and decides to block this one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Glorious! Floated outside off, Ali leans into it and drives it elegantly through extra cover to find the fence.

Not Out! Sri Lanka lose a review! Full delivery around off, Ali kneels to paddle sweep it but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. Perera is confident and so are his teammates. However, umpire Richard Kettleborough stays put. Chandimal looks at his bowler and decides to finally take the review. Time for the replays. Surprise. The Snicko doesn't spot any inside edge and there is no glove as well. The Hawk Eye rolls in. Alas, the impact is well outside off and it also not spinning back enough to hit the stumps either. A desperate review really!
Chandimal after a long thought decides to take a review against Azhar Ali. It is regarding an LBW decision. The impact is in question and there might be an inside edge as well.
Flatter delivery on middle, helped nicely around the corner to rotate strike.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Sohail eases it to sweeper cover for a run and will retain strike.
Fuller in length, angling in. Haris shuffles a bit and taps it to mid on.
Good length delivery well outside off, Sohail plants his front foot across and watches it go.
Tries to tuck Azhar with a short one. He hops and works it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Hits the deck hard but this one is down the leg side. Azhar doesn't bother to play at it.

Good fielding! Pradeep  comes around the wicket and bowls it around the hips, Ali tucks it uppishly but in the gap through backward square leg. Sandakan sprints all the way from fine leg and slides to make a good stop. Saves a couple for his side.
Leg gully and backward short leg in place. Seems like Ali is going to be tested with the short stuff.
On the pads, defended besides the pitch on the leg side. The debutant is looking solid in the middle.
Fraction short this time, coming in with the arm. Haris clips it to short leg.
Landed on middle and leg, Sohail shows the full face of the bat to block it.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and turns it to short mid-wicket.
This time Sohail eases it to the right side of Perera who dives full length to make a good stop.
Fullish delivery on middle, pushed to the left side of the bowler.
Full length delivery outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a single.
Short delivery, climbing on Haris. He ducks but keeps his bat in the air like a periscope. Manages to evade it though. Needs to be careful.
Length delivery well outside off, Sohail doesn't fiddle with it.
Pradeep bangs this one short on middle and leg, Haris sits underneath the bumper.

FOUR! Shot! Not much use of the feet but the hand-eye co-ordination was great. Fullish delivery outside off, Sohail creams it through covers and the ball whistles away to the fence. The timing was spot on there.
Pradeep comes around the wicket and angles it in from outside off. Sohail covers his off stump to allow it through.
He is again nimble on his feet to the flighted delivery outside off and buries it down the track.
Azhar uses his feet this time to push it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Ali lunges forward in defense.
Straying on the pads, worked around the corner for a run.
Nervy moment! Slider around off, coming in with the angle. Sohail stays back and looks to defend it tentatively but gets an inside edge onto his pads. That could have easily gone back on the stumps.
Fullish delivery around off, Sohail leans ahead and blocks it right under his eyes.
That is nasty! Pradeep again bowls a bouncer but this time it doesn't rise. Ali is caught in a tangle as he takes it on his left shoulder. There is a lot of variable bounce on this track.
This is good bowling from Pradeep. He is bowling his heart out. Goes wider of the crease and hits the deck hard. Ali ducks under it to evade it.
Length delivery on middle, worked to mid-wicket.

Not in control of that but in the gap! Banged in short on middle, Ali is not in a comfortable position and ends up top edging his pull towards fine leg. Sandakan rushes to his right and keeps it down to a couple.
Ali gets his first runs of the day! Length delivery outside off, Ali leans into it and strokes it through covers for a brace.
Pradeep goes wider of the crease and angles it on a fullish length. Ali taps it to the off side.
Quicker delivery around off, Sohail makes good use of the depth of the crease to defend it calmly.
Stays back to this one and defends it solidly.
A fraction short, coming in with the arm. Answered with a straight bat to mid on.
Persists in that off stump channel, defended solidly off the front foot.
Flatter on off, Haris covers the line to block it.
Tossed up on off, Sohail leans ahead and pushes it to covers.
Fuller in length, searching for some swing and generates some from outside off. Azhar knows where his off stump is and makes a good leave.
Good length delivery outside off, stays low. Ali doesn't fiddle with it.
Pradeep bends his back and opts for the effort delivery. Bangs it on middle and leg but it doesn't take off much. Ali ducks under it easily.
Back of a length outside off, Azhar Ali camps back and punches it to covers.
Length delivery, shaping into Ali. He shuffles across and tucks it to mid-wicket.
No ball! Fuller in length, angling in from around off. Ali lunges forward and defends it confidently. Pradeep has overstepped on this occasion.
Length delivery in the zone of apprehension, Azhar camps back and defends it stoutly to short cover.
Loopy delivery, Haris puts his head down and defends it calmly. Perera starts the day with a maiden!
Floated outside off, Haris drives it to short cover.
Landed on middle, patted back to the bowler.
Shortish outside off, coming in with the arm. Haris shapes for the cut but is cramped for room. Ends up chopping it to short third man.
A bit quicker on leg stump, Sohail lunges forward in defense.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl from the other end.
Similar length delivery outside off, Haris dabs it deftly past the gully region. Will pick up three runs for doing so.
FOUR! What a way to begin your Test career! Confidence at its best! Good length delivery outside off, Sohail cuts it late in the gap through backward point and gully to find the fence.

We are set to get underway. Azhar Ali to continue his innings while Haris Sohail, the debutant joins him at the crease. Nuwan Pradeep to continue his over. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Pakistan still trail by 153 runs with 6 wickets in hand. The first aim of the hosts will be to go past the visitors and then up the scoring rate. However, it won't be an easy task as their lower middle order is not that experienced. The tourists will bank on their go-to-man, Rangana Herath to turn things around. Pradeep is also bending his back and will be eager to make the ball talk. Let's see who comes out on top today.

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 4 of the first Test match between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Abu Dhabi. The bowlers have toiled so far in the sweltering heat and it has been a grinding task for the batsmen as well. To add to it, the track is slow and low but there is no alarming turn. Amidst all this, Azhar Ali has stood tall, composed as ever.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

It was a long day for the Islanders. They were made to work hard and really apply themselves in the baking Abu Dhabi sun. They'd have liked a wicket or two more, but will be fairly happy with how they've finished the day. The track is slow and difficult for both batsmen and bowlers. It was evident by the rate at which the runs were being scored. With the hosts still trailing by 153, the Lankans have the chance to make further inroads from here as the Pakistan lower middle order isn't as experienced. So join us tomorrow for Day 4 to see how it all unfolds. Till then, cheers!

The day mostly belongs to Pakistan, but this wicket right at the stroke of stumps has given Sri Lanka something to smile about. It's evident in the way Nuwan Pradeep just celebrated there. The day started off with the two openers being dismissed just before the end of the first session. Then Azhar Ali, who's unbeaten still, threaded two vital stands with Asad Shafiq first and Babar Azam next. All was going well for the hosts before Babar threw his wicket away rather softly.

OUT! OH YES, HE'S DELIVERED! His skipper wanted him to bring one home for the team and he's done what he's always does, delivered! Nuwan Pradeep with the breakthrough. This is sensational. But, to be honest, it's a soft dismissal in the end. Not the kind of delivery you'd want to get out to, Babar Azam will be disappointed in himself. Angling down leg, Babar looks to tickle it fine and gets some glove on it. Dickwella behind the stumps dives to his left and collects it well. A good partnership of 71 has been broken. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Low full toss on off, Azam off the bottom half drives it to the right of the bowler.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, guarded out on the off side.
That just took off! Pradeep pounds in a bumper around off, Azam ducks and Dickwella had to leap high to keep a hold of that.
The last over of the day is coming up.
Wicket-to-wicket line from Perera, defended rather comfortably by Azhar Ali.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Touch and go from this current pair. Azam drops it in front of cover and sets off. Beats the throw at the bowler's end and gets there comfortably.
Straighter one outside off, defended off the outer half.
Spinning in with some extra bounce, Azam comes half-forward and keeps it out off the top half of the bat.
Short and flat on middle and off, punched to mid on from the back foot.
Bit fuller than a length, outside the line of off stump, driven to cover with his front foot planted across.
Brings the short one out of nowhere as he bangs it in hard. Azhar Ali, however, is alert to it as he crouches really low to let it sail over his head.
Quite straighter in line, Azhar Ali with his bat ahead of his pad defends it back down the track.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, Azhar picks it off his pads and nudges it to man at short mid-wicket.
On a length again, outside off, punched solidly to the left of the cover fielder.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, driven through to sweeper cover for a run.
Nuwan Pradeep is called back into the attack. Chandimal is looking for a little miracle from his pacer. Can he deliver?
Darts it full on the stumps, almost like a pacer's delivery, driven to mid on.
Zero amount of turn on this from Dilruwan, Azhar works it straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and flat, angling into the pads, Azhar brings his bat 'round his pads to defend it on the on side.
Full again, Azam leans across and wrists it to deep backward square leg for an easy run.
Full and pitched outside off, comes forward to meet it with the full face of the bat.
Comes down the track and blocks it out with the full face.
Fuller outside off, drilled to extra cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Clips it through square leg off the inner half for a run.

Straighter one outside off on a driving length, Azam is forward to defend. There's a loud shout from Herath as the ball hits the pads. Though, it seems he clearly failed to see the big inside edge before that happened. Hence, umpire Nigel Llong offers nothing in response.
Flighted full and in the zone around off, Babar skips out of his crease to push it away before the ball spins.
Slider coming in from around off, Azam comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner half on the pads.
Full and straight, blocked.
Turns it with the spin and works it to the mid-wicket area. Dot ball.
Comes down the track this time and Azhar Ali displays another way in which you can defend.
Drags his length back around off, Ali goes back but still just defends.
Another one of the fuller side of things, blocks it out off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, brings down a straight bat to defend.
Defended off the front foot by Babar Azam presenting the full face of the bat.
Drives again, down the ground but it's straight to the mid off fielder.
Floated ball on middle and off, a little stab from Babar on the off side.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. He's timed that so well. A lot of flight from Herath, Azam with a little shimmy down the track drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Not much foot movement on this occasion, just stays inside the crease and guards well.
Straightaway tosses it up with a lot of revs, Babar Azam plants his front foot forward and defends.
Works it to the man at mid-wicket with the spin. That'll be the end of the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on leg, the flick misses and the ball goes off the pads on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Some loop on this occasion, defended.

Tad short on middle and off, Babar backs away to hack it on the off side but the low bounce takes the bottom edge and thuds him on the pads. Risky, risky stuff. Shouldn't be trying such things when the track is so uneven.
Quicker through the air on off, met with a straight bat in defense.
Quick and short outside off, cut away square on the off side for a single.
Stands his ground and pushes it out with a defensive bat.
Sliding in on leg stump, whipped away through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Spinning too far down leg, Azhar lets it be. Dickwella has difficulty to gather it so the ball goes behind. Two byes are taken.
Goes on straight as it's dropped on a shorter length outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out to end a maiden over from Dilruwan.
Steps out to get close to the pitch and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Full and slow through the air around off, Azam dead-bats it right under his nose.
Babar Azam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and loopy outside off, Babar looks to drive but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length, outside off, punched away into the off side.
Short and wide outside off, it should have been put away but Azam cuts Sandakan a break. Only takes a single via a punch through the covers.
Outside off on a fuller length, Azam misses his attempted sweep shot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Uses the crease well, goes deep inside and dabs it with an open face to point.
Just back of a driving length, Azam steps out and push it out defensively.
Starts off from around the wicket and gets it to turn in from around off, Azam goes back and offers a punch to the cover fielder.
Ali gets to the pitch of the ball once again, offers a tight defense.
Another forward block from Azhar Ali. Tightly done.
Teasing flight outside off, on a driving length inviting Azhar Ali forward. He obliges but only blocks.
The 250 is up for Pakistan! Babar Azam brings it up with a single behind square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Darts it down the leg side, Azam looks to flick but misses.
Brings his wrists into play and works it away to mid on. Can't get it wide of him so no run is taken.
This is around off, Ali kneels to drag the sweep but can only manage to get if off the bottom part behind to first slip.
Leans ahead to a fullish ball from Sandakan and meets it with a tight defensive block.
Wrong one around off, Babar picks it up, waits for it and guides it behind square on the off side for a single.

FOUR! The 50-run stand is up! This is a good shot and a good partnership for Pakistan. The current pair has to carry on though. Tossed up outside off, Babar Azam drives it hard through the covers for a boundary.
A lot of air given by Lakshan, wristed through mid-wicket for a run.
Works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. He did well to get close to the pitch using his feet and whip it away.
Comes half-forward to this flighted ball and buries it into the track.
Flatter and a tad shorter on middle and off, worked away to the mid-wicket area for a run.
Pitched right up there, Babar is playing for the turn when there is none and hence draws an edge. It flies past the slip fielder and goes behind while the batsmen take one.
Shimmies down the wicket and eases it to long on to get off strike.

FOUR! That's a good shot. Saw the field beforehand, picked his spot well and executed the shot to perfection. Azhar Ali goes across and kneels down to this and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. Nobody out there, so that's a well played shot.
Dilruwan Perera is back.
Loops it up outside the line of off stump, Babar moves a step across and deals with it well.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Lands it shorter and outside off, pushed out off the back foot.
Darts it full and quicker through the air, Ali clips it in front of square on the leg side and takes two because of the big gap out there on the leg side.
Spinning back in on middle and leg, works it with the spin to the man at mid-wicket.
Flights it right up there, Ali pushes it out with a defensive bat.
Lakshan Sandakan to roll his arm over.
Just ahead of a length around off, driven to extra cover.
Fires it down the leg side, Babar looks to flick but misses and so does the keeper. It goes off his gloves and behind and seeing this opportunity, the batsmen steal two byes.
Fuller length ball attacking the stumps, it's driven back to the bowler.
Length delivery around the off pole, Babar walks across a step and defends by getting behind the line.
Keeps it fuller but outside off this time, driven to the cover fielder.
A hint of reverse for Karunaratne. It's full and coming back in on middle and leg, Azam drives it towards wide mid on.
Drinks are on the field!
Bit full outside off, a little more than Perera would have liked, Babar drives it a bit square through cover-point for one run.
Slower through the air, surprisingly, from Dilruwan Perera and Azhar Ali works it through the gap in the leg side for a single.
Seeing the ball dropped a little short, Azhar Ali quickly goes deep inside his crease to play it out off the back foot.
Flatter ball on the pads, Babar Azam works it in front of square leg for a run.
Pushed quicker through the air, outside off, pushed to the cover area. No run taken.
Dilruwan with some rare flight on this, Azam defends it on the on side.
Short of a good length outside off, punched square through backward point by Babar Azam for a single.
Outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Gentle medium pace on middle and off, Ali drives this fuller length ball back to the bowler.
Going down leg this time, looks to flick but fails to make connection.
Dimuth with a delivery which is a bit straightish in line, Ali flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Ali gets inside the line and taps it to the on side.
Dimuth Karunaratne back on to have a go with the ball.
Floats it just outside off, the batsman plants his front foot forward and blocks.
Down the leg side, no shot offered.
No ball! A rare one from a spinner. Dilruwan bowling it full and straight which is defended solidly by Azam. Umpire signals no ball for overstepping.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Looped up on middle and off, flicked to mid-wicket.
Touch short and pitched outside off, Babar backs away and punches it into the covers for a single.
Not much spin on this, Babar keeps it out.
Dilruwan Perera returns.
FOUR! That's a scintillating shot! Overpitched delivery on off, Azhar Ali gets right behind the line by leaning a touch across and drives it hard past the mid on fielder for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Plays it to mid-wicket again, straight to the fielder this time.
Full ball on the stumps, Babar Azam nudges it wide of mid on to steal a quick run.
Again it's too straight, flicked away through mid-wicket by Babar. There's a slight misfield from Sandakan out in the deep but not much harm done. Two runs taken.
Full and straight from Pradeep, flicked away towards mid-wicket where the fielder makes a half-stop. Single taken.
Positions himself right behind the line and blocks.
Straight from Rangi, attacking the stumps, played right back to the bowler.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Looped up outside off, Azhar looks to sweep it away but does so wildly. Misses the shot and almost loses his balance in the process. Could have been stumped. Close call.
Spinning away from around off, Azhar watching it go away doesn't bother himself with it.
Slider pretty straight in line, flicked to the leg side for an easy run.
Easy pickings for Azhar! Receives it on his pads and nudges this through mid-wicket for a single.
Brings his bat around his pads and works it away to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Back of a length around off, punched away off the back foot.
Outside off on a good length, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Straighter in line on middle and leg, worked away in front of square leg.

26th Test fifty for Azhar Ali! He's one of those players who sticks around for a long time when he gets his eye in. Proving that here again today. He just flicks this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. He'll look to hang around like Dinesh Chandimal and get a big score.
Floated outside off, driven to extra cover where it is stopped well.
Drifting into Ali. He clips it through mid-wicket. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to complete three runs.
Outside off, coming in with the angle. Ali plants his front foot across to leave it alone.
He is again nimble on his feet and wrists it to mid on.
Ali uses his feet to and pushes it back to Herath.
Quicker through the air outside off, Azam skips down the track and places it to mid off for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Ali slaps it to short cover where the fielder parries it with a dive to extra cover.
Full length delivery on off, Azhar drives it on the up past the bowler to mid off.
Pradeep steams it and hits the deck hard outside off, generates extra bounce. Ali prods forward but is surprised a bit. Ends up fending it off past gully for a couple.
Angling in from a good length outside off, Azhar points his bat skywards to leave it.
On a length around off, shaping in. Azhar keeps it out with a straight bat.
Good length delivery well outside off, holding its line. Ali lets it go.
The Pakistani players are taking a breather. The heat is taking a toll on the players.
Slow through the air on off, Azam lunges forward in defense.
Outside off, spinning away. Babar pushes it off the front foot to short cover.
Lunges to the tossed up delivery to block it.
Flighted outside off, knocked to the same region.
Azam is nimble on his feet and eases the fullish delivery to mid off.
On middle and leg, defended solidly off the front foot.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Ali doesn't flirt with it.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, a hint of away swing there. Azhar points his bat skywards to leave it alone.

FOUR! Glorious! Fuller length delivery on off, Ali stays well-balanced and clips it uppishly through mid-wicket. All timing and grace and the ball whistles away to the ropes. This is his first boundary of the innings. He has been rock solid so far.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali plays it with a vertical bat to mid off.
Length delivery, angling in from outside off. Azhar works it off the inner half to mid-wicket. His bottom hand came off while playing that stroke.
Overpitched on middle, patted back towards Lakmal who bends and makes a half-stop. The ball rolls towards mid off.
Full delivery outside off, Azam decides to pad it away. A loud appeal for an LBW but that was way outside off.
Landed outside off, stroked to short cover.

Cheeky! Ali kneels and paddle sweeps the fullish delivery on off past the keeper. Thirimanne from first slip and Lakmal from short fine leg give it a chase. The latter reaches it first. Saves a run for his side.

As mentioned a little earlier, Rangana Herath is dangerous with the new ball. He averages just 19.10 in the first 10 overs after taking the new ball. You can see a glimpse of that now. He dismissed Asad Shafiq and justified that stat further. Killer!
Tossed up in line of the stumps, kept out off the back foot.
Drifting in on middle, Babar looks to block it but gets it off the inner half to short fine leg. A run taken.
Floated delivery, Azam prods forward in defense.
In the zone outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish delivery outside off, holding its line. Azhar points his bat skywards to let it go.
Sliding down the leg side, Azhar looks to clip it away but misses. Dickwella moves to his left to collect it.
Fullish outside off, Ali mistimes his drive to covers.
Length delivery outside off, Ali strides forward to block it.
Babar Azam strides out to bat.

OUT! The veteran strikes! Look at him, he is absolutely pumped up! Intelligent bowling and he gets the reward! Tosses this one outside off and gets it to spin away sharply with a bit of extra bounce. Shafiq prods forward and looks to leave it at the last moment but he is too late to make that decision. The ball catches the outside edge of Asad's bat and flies towards Thirimanne at first slip. He is sharp as a hawk and bends to his right to take it inches above the ground. Big breakthrough for the hosts. End of the 79-run stand. Pakistan trail by 224 runs.
Uses his feet and drives it to mid on.
Around off, coming in with the arm. Shafiq pushes at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting into Asad. He leans forward and blocks it.
Floated outside off, played with an open bat face towards point.
Rangana Herath to continue his spell.
Good length delivery, angling in from around off. Ali turns it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, shaping away. Azhar doesn't fiddle with it.
Good length delivery outside off, swinging away with some extra bounce. Ali points his bat skywards to leave it alone.
Angling into the hips, tucked around the corner for a run.
A bit of a delay. Shafiq is struggling with cramps in his hands and the physio comes out to attend him. Hopefully, he will be alright.
Similar delivery outside off, stays low. Shafiq leaves it alone.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Shafiq leans ahead and eases it to covers.
We are back for the evening session. Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq to continue their innings. Suranga Lakmal to share the second new ball from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

So an excellent session for Pakistan. They've gone wicketless in this session scoring 73 runs in 30 overs. The experienced pair of Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq has dealt with the Lankan spin threat considerably well and kept the scoreboard ticking away. The visitors should have done more, given there has been assistance from the track for the spinners. This last session will be crucial for both teams in terms of who holds the upper hand in this game. Should be an intriguing one to witness. It'll start shortly, so don't go anywhere.
Once again Azhar comes down the track to negotiate the spin, misses it and gets hit on the body. He's safe and that's TEA ON DAY 3!
Azhar Ali dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Sliding in with the arm, turned to square leg off the inner half for a run.
Full and in line of the stumps, keeps it out with the full face of the bat.

A half-shout for an lbw! Was never going to be given out though. From around the wicket, Herath floats it around leg, Ali kneels to sweep but misses and is caught on the front pad. Was always going down leg, so the umpire doesn't bother with the appeal at all. A leg bye taken.
Drops this just back of a driving length, Ali skips down and blocks it out.
The second new ball has been taken. And it will be Rangana Herath to take it first up.

Another shot which deserved a boundary, but undone by the slow outfield. Azhar uses his feet well and drives the ball through the covers by getting close to the pitch. It's chased down with a slide just inside the rope and three runs are collected.
Off spinner on middle and leg, Asad whips it with the turn past short leg. Easy single taken by the batsmen.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Not much spin on this occasion, it's wristed towards mid on. No run taken.
Full, quick and flat on middle and leg, Azhar leans forward and across as he paddles this fine down the leg side. Picks up a single for doing so.
Steps out of the crease to this loopy ball and drives it to long on for a single.
Spinning in from off, worked away on the leg side.
Quite full in length, Shafiq brings out the sweep and brooms it through square leg for a single.

Picks up the wrong 'un this time, goes back and taps it towards gully for an easy run. With this, Azhar Ali reaches 5000 runs in Test match cricket. An excellent player who has completely deserved to reach this milestone. He's an important player for Pakistan, a lot of responsibility on his shoulders.
Looped up on off stump this time, Ali keeping bat and pad close together defends.
Another googly, but it's pitched wide outside off. Ali looks to go after it but misses.
Googly around off, Ali blocks it by coming on the front foot.
The second new ball is available for Sri Lanka to take. They haven't taken it yet for some reason.
Short, wide and outside off, Shafiq makes a little room for himself and cracks it through the gap in the covers. Picks up a couple of comfortable runs as the fielder chases it down.
Bit fuller in length this time, Shafiq is rock solid in his defense.
Over the wicket now, it's darted on middle and off, Shafiq meets the ball with a straight bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Straighter one on the pads, worked away on the on side.

From around the wicket, it's darted across Azhar Ali. He comes down the track and pushes it to mid off. There is a shy at the bowler's end but nobody there to back it up. So the batsmen take a single as a result.
Fullish outside off, Asad drives it crisply to wide mid off.
Ali is nimble on his feet and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Puts his head down to the the tossed up delivery on off and defends it calmly.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Full toss on off, Shafiq sweeps it straight to backward square leg. Perhaps it is too full to sweep.
Tossed up on middle, Azhar clips it through in front of square leg. He wants the second but is sent back by Shafiq.
Fullish delivery outside off, Shafiq times it sweetly to mid off.
Strides ahead to the floated delivery and blocks it nicely.
Down the leg side, Shafiq misses out on his flick. Dickwella fails to collect it cleanly. A rare occasion he has done so.
Spinning into Asad. He cuts it to covers.
On leg stump, Ali takes it on the full and paddles it to short fine leg to rotate strike.
On the pads, turned around the corner.
Floated in line of the stumps, kept out watchfully. Maiden over!
Flighted outside off, Shafiq stride forward to block it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shortish delivery on off, Asad hangs back and punches it to mid on.
Slow through the air on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, eased to extra cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Worked away through the mid-wicket area for a run.
Turns it with the spin in front of square leg.
Leans into this full ball and drives it to the mid on fielder.
From around the wicket, it's on middle and leg, Asad makes a little room and pushes it to the covers.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Dilruwan Perera has a change of ends.
Another front foot defense presented by the batsman.
Some loop on this, it is blocked.
Fraction straighter in line, full in length, whipped to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Ali works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a brisk run.
Full, fast and flat on middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Dimuth Karunaratne is introduced into the bowling attack. Sri Lanka trying something new to break this partnership.
Darts it on leg, or around leg, which is why Shafiq fearlessly pads it out.
Turns it to the leg side for no run.
FOUR! Aggressive intent from Asad Shafiq. This is good batting. He sees the flight on it from Sandakan and skips out. Plays across the line as he lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and defends.

FOUR! The 50-run stand is up! Good batting from this experienced pair. Slower through the air, just back of a driving length on off. Shafiq drives this crisply and beats mid off. The fielder gives it everything to chase it down but can't do so. A rare occasion when the outfield didn't stop it from getting to the rope.
Azhar Ali makes good use of his feet and takes it on the full, hits it through the covers and takes a single.
Lakshan Sandakan is back to bowl.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square for nothing.
Plants his front foot forward and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Drives it towards mid on again, just wide of the fielder and a quick single is taken this time.
Fullish in length around off, comes half-forward to defend.
Darted full and straight, on the stumps, driven to mid on. Won't get any run for it though.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and straight, driven to mid on for nothing.

Just what happened here right now? Total miscommunication between Kaushal Silva and Kusal Mendis! Shafiq stands tall and offers a firm punch through the covers. The slow outfield stops the ball from reaching its destination. Silva is chases it down, slides and parries it back towards Mendis who runs to help him out. But, the parry is too powerful and goes over the latter's head. This allows the batsmen to take the fourth run as well. Comical stuff, really.
Makes the batsman play this time, brings it in closer on a good length. It's kept out from the back foot.
This is close to the off stump now but still well outside off, Asad Shafiq with another leave.
Wide outside off, Shafiq is never going to bother himself with that.
Too full on middle, no trouble for Azhar Ali to turn it just past short leg.
Plays it with the spin and works it away square on the leg side for one.
Presses forward and dead-bats it right under his nose.
Spinning in after landing on off, beats the bat and raps the batsman on the thigh pad.
Short and wide outside off, Shafiq makes room and cuts it away. Is unable to beat the point fielder though who moves to his right to make a tumbling stop.
Darts it full and quite straight in line, Shafiq presents a tight defensive shot.
Dilruwan Perera is back on.
Fires it full but down the leg side, the batsman attempts to tickle it fine but fails to make any connection.
Bumper on the stumps, Ali ducks and evades.

Oh, that was close! At 136 clicks, Nuwan Pradeep makes this jag back in a long way from outside off. Azhar Ali walks a step across but doesn't expect the heavy movement. Tries guiding it behind square on the off side but instead gets an inside edge back onto his pads. Could have just as easily chopped it back on.
Closer to off this time, on a good length once more. Ali stands tall and punches it on the off side.
Bowls it nicely on a length on the fourth stump line, it's moving back in as Azhar covers the line and shoulders his arms to it.
Angling back in on middle and leg, Shafiq works it to mid-wicket with a closed face for a single.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Floated delivery around off, driven to mid on.
Similar ball, same shot. Into the covers again for nothing.
Slower through the air outside off, pushed into the covers.
Sliding in on middle stump, Ali brings a straight bat down and gets it off the inside edge past short leg. Two runs are quickly taken.
Floats it up around off, Ali takes a step out of his crease and keeps it out.
Drinks time.

Well bowled! Pradeep goes wider of the crease and angles it in substantially on a fuller length. Shafiq aims to push it down the ground but gets an inside edge on his pads. Had he missed that, he would have been LBW.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Length delivery outside off, holding its line. Asad plants his front foot across to allow it through.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali punches it through covers for a run. There are chats of Pakistan, Pakistan in the stadium.
A bit fuller this time outside off, Azhar doesn't fiddle with it.
Starts off his new spell with a good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Ali watches it closely and leaves it alone.
Nuwan Pradeep comes back for a burst.
Floated on middle, kept out watchfully.
FOUR! Hit with authority! Shafiq needs to play such strokes at times to unsettle the rhythm of Herath. Around off, Shafiq takes it on the full and sweeps it through square leg to pick up a boundary.
Fuller delivery on off, knocked to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on off, Asad prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge towards first slip.
Floated outside off, eased to covers.

Quicker delivery down the leg side, Ali looks to help it away but misses. Dickwella collects it nicely and roars in appeal. However, the umpire is unmoved. Niroshan is flabbergasted but Sri Lanka decide not to take a review. The replays show that it was close to the glove but there was no deviation.
On the pads, flicked to backward square leg for a tight run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Flighted delivery outside off, Shafiq plays for the turn but it is not on offer. Ends up getting a thick outside edge past first slip. Couple taken.
Floated delivery, Asad clips it straight to short mid-wicket this time.
Tossed up outside off, Ali clips it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his left to parry the ball to mid on. A run taken.
Slow through the air outside off, Shafiq knocks it down to mid off.
Strides forward to the loopy delivery and taps it to covers.
Sliding down leg, Ali misses out on his nudge. The ball brushes his pads and rolls to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Ali kneels and takes it on the full to sweep it to backward square leg.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Drifting into the pads, Ali brings his bat down at an angle and clips it to short mid-wicket.
Slow through the air outside off, Shafiq lunges forward in defense.
Fired in towards Ali. Clipped past the mid-wicket fielder for a single. There were shouts of catch it but it was well wide of the concerned fielder. A single taken.
Spinning in sharply into Azhar. He makes use of the depth of the crease and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the pads, turned to the short leg fielder again.
Full delivery on middle, clipped straight to the man at short leg. Ali was on the move but he does well to get back in the crease.
Floated outside off, Shafiq lunges forward in defense.
Darted in on a fuller length on middle and leg, Asad keeps it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting into Shafiq. He looks to block it but is struck on the pads again.
Smart bowling from Herath! Loads of experience coming to the fore. Shafiq uses his feet and Rangana spots that. Fires it on leg stump to beat his defence and raps him on the pads.
Tossed up on off, defended with the spin to silly point.
Fullish around off, stroked to wide mid on.
Strides ahead to the tossed up delivery and blocks it with authority.
Leg bye! That one turned and gripped! Pitches on off and turns in sharply. Shafiq tries to play it across but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to backward square leg. A run taken.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Floated around off, eased to mid on.
Full toss on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket.
Great effort! Fullish delivery outside off, Ali thumps it towards Thirimanne at cover-point who dives to stop a certain boundary. He is all smiles.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Slow through the air outside off, Azhar defends it with soft hands towards silly point. He dives to his left to stop it but the ball spins past him.
Uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Azhar drills it towards short cover where the fielder dives to his right to make a sharp stop.
Flatter delivery outside off, pushed past the silly point fielder.
Wrong one outside off at a quicker pace, placed through point for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, driven to the right side of Sandakan who rushes across to deny a run.
Clips this one with the spin towards mid-wicket. Ali searches for a run but it is not on offer.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Googly outside off, Shafiq cuts it with the spin through point for a run. The batsmen see Herath charge towards the ball and don't take the veteran on for the second.
FOUR! Aggression from Shafiq! What a blow! Flighted outside off, Asad kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a one-bounce boundary. That came out of nowhere.
Fullish around off, tailing in. Ali shuffles across to turn it to short mid-wicket.
Fullish length delivery outside off, tapped to covers.
Shaping in from outside off again. Ali brings his bat close to his pad and manages to keep it out.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.

Angling in from a fullish length around off, stays a touch low. Ali puts his head down and defends it off the inner half down the track. If he missed that, he would have been a candidate for an LBW. His bottom hand came off while blocking it.
Full length delivery outside off, Azhar pushes it off the front foot to mid off.
This time the googly is at a quicker outside off, Shafiq shapes for the cut but bails out of it at the last moment.

Good bowling from Sandakan! Slips in the googly on off. Turns away slowly. That gives Ali enough time to read it off the pitch. It stays low but he places it behind point. Herath covers a lot of distance from sweeper cover to his left and saves a run for his side.
Leg bye! Down the leg side, Asad aims to work it across but is hit on the pad. The ball rolls towards fine leg. A run taken.
Allows this one to spin back to him and punches it back to the bowler.
Quicker through the air on middle, Ali whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish outside off, driven to the right of Sandakan who dives and makes a good stop.
Fuller length delivery outside off, shapes away on this occasion. Shafiq moves his feet outside off and leaves it alone.
Straying on the hips, tucked around the corner for an easy single.
Good length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the back foot to short cover.
Angling in sharply from outside off, Ali shuffles across and looks to block it with his bat close to the pad but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Pacy delivery on a fullish length around off, a hint of reverse swing again. Azhar is a bit hurried by it but does well to get his bat down in time.
Full length delivery outside off, tailing in a bit. Ali strides confidently to the pitch of the ball and strokes it to wide mid off.
Fullish on off, Asad knocks it down to mid on.
Floated outside off, patted back to the bowler.
Similar delivery, probably quicker in pace. Shafiq tries to cut it but mistimes it to covers.

Shorter delivery around off, Ali makes use of the depth of the crease and punches it nicely through covers. The fielder from the same region hares after it to save a run for his side on this slow outfield.
On the pads, helped through backward square leg for a single.
Starts off with a loosener outside off, Shafiq drills it straight to the fielder at extra cover.
Lakshan Sandakan is back on.
Leg bye!  Angling into Shafiq. He looks to play it across but is hit on the pads and the ball rolls to the leg side. A single taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish delivery, angling in from outside off. Azhar strides forward to defend it but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket. A single taken.
Bowled with a scrambled seam in the zone of apprehension, stays very low. Ali plants his front foot across to leave it alone. That died on the keeper.
Fuller in length around off, Ali prods forward and pushes it to mid off.

Sri Lanka have been ordinary in the field today! They need to be alert and back their bowlers up in this hot weather. On a length outside off, Ali strokes it to Chandimal at extra cover who makes a mess of it allowing it to go through. Concedes a couple.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl from the other end. Meanwhile, Herath gets the thumb of his right hand taped. He will probably be back for a bowl soon.
On the pads, helped to short fine leg.
Loose shot! Spinning in from a shorter length around off, Shafiq rocks back, exposes his stumps and tries to cut it but is cramped for room. Ends up getting a bottom edge on it.
Floated on off, Asad lunges forward in defense.
Shorter delivery on middle, spinning down. Shafiq aims to work it across but is struck on the thigh pad.
Strides forward confidently and works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish on off, Ali drives it to mid on.
We are back for the afternoon session. Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq to continue their innings. Dilruwan Perera to bowl first up after Lunch. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

The middle order has got a good platform and they need to capitalize on it. A lot of responsibility lies on the current pair of Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq to stitch a substantial stand and keep the scoreboard ticking. It won't be easy though as the Lankan spinners have their tails up with Pakistan still trailing by 298 runs. Join us in a while for the second session.

Session highlights - 30 overs, 57 runs, two wickets. Sri Lanka have fought back well to dismiss both the openers. Sami Aslam and Shan Masood after reaching their fifties departed soon after. First signs of the pitch cracking up and things have started happening. We all know how dangerous Herath can be on a deteriorating wicket.

Not out! That wasn't too far off really. Some lightning glovework from Niroshan Dickwella almost dismissed Asad Shafiq. Sandakan bowls the googly around off which Shafiq doesn't pick. He comes forward to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves. He whips the bails off in a flash and appeals loudly. It's taken upstairs and after several angles on the replays, the third umpire decides to signal not out. Was a very close call, probably didn't have clear evidence whether his foot was on the line or behind it. Cannot blame him either. In any case, Pakistan survive a scare and that shall be LUNCH ON DAY 3!
There is a stumping appeal against Asad Shafiq which is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full around off, wristed to mid on.
Loopy full toss outside leg, Shafiq kneels down and sweeps it towards short fine leg.
Full and straight, too full actually yet again, Shafiq can play it before it turns as he pushes it back to the bowler.
Flights it right up there, Asad can block it without much trouble.
Lakshan Sandakan will bowl the last over before lunch.
With a straight front hand and a steady head, Azhar Ali is forward in defense. Good technique shown.
Turning and bouncing a touch on off, blocked.
Picks the gap out yet again. Eases it nicely through the gap in the covers and comes back for the second. Thirimanne does well to chase the ball down and throw it back in.
Skates down the wicket and pushes the ball back out.
Herath gives it some decent air and tosses it up on middle, Ali with a solid front foot defense.

That could have been dangerous. Dropped short and it kept really low, Shafiq went back to pull and did well at the last second to adjust and get his bat down in time before eventually playing it through backward square leg. One run taken.
Superbly done. Sweetly leans into the shot and drives it through the gap in the covers for a double.
Landed around off and it drifts it away a bit, Azhar goes deep inside his crease and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Quick once more, the batsman looks to get some bat on it and does so, but it's only an inside edge onto his pads.
It's pushed quicker through the air again, driven to mid on. Dot ball.
Short and flat just outside off, Azhar Ali hangs back and taps it down next to him.
Quicker through the air on middle stump, it's driven down to mid on for no run.
Too full and outside off, eased away to the cover area.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Straighter one on middle and off, easily negotiated by the batsman.
Sliding in on middle and leg, catches Asad on the pads as he looks to play at it. Stifled shout, but it was always going down leg.
Spinning away from around off on a bit of a fuller length, Shafiq pushes it into the covers.
A lot of flight from Herath, Shafiq is forward in defense.
Full in length, played off the front foot to end the over.
Presses ahead to meet the ball at its pitch and smothers it in its tracks.
No spin on this occasion, easy for Azhar to block it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, driven to mid on with ease.
Full and flat, darted on the stumps, Ali goes back and keeps it out.
Full and straight, driven back down the track to the bowler.
Waits for the ball to come to him and defends it safely.
Asad Shafiq is the next batsman in.

OUT! Rangana Herath has started to weave his magic here. Some assistance from the pitch and he's scalped his first wicket. A poor shot from Masood as well, should have been more careful while playing this. Loopy ball on off, it spins in a lot as Shan kneels across to sweep it away. He, however, leaves his stumps exposed and has his leg stump knocked over. Sri Lanka have two quick wickets and will feel quite confident right now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Some flight on this occasion, it's swept away nicely on the leg side for a single.
Looped up around off, Azhar gets to the pitch and pushes it away.
The wicket is finally showing signs of something. It has started to turn and grip a lot. The match will get interesting now in terms of how the Pakistan batsmen face the spin threat.
