The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and straight from Dilruwan, played back to him.
Appeal for an lbw, nothing from the umpire.

Huge bite off the wicket. Now the batsmen are really going to be tested. Tossed up on off and it grips and turns sharply. Beats the outside edge of Masood's bat and goes behind. Even Dickwella couldn't keep a hold of that.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it out.
From around the wicket, floated on middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Drives this full ball again to the covers and that's the end of the over.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to the covers for nothing.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full in length and around off, driven to mid on for a run.
Dropped short in length, kept out off the back foot.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out safely.
Takes a step out and drives it to mid on.
Outside off, defended into the off side.

NOT OUT! Well, well, well... This is a surprise. It's actually the inside edge that's saved Azhar Ali. Pitched outside off and it spins in sharply, Azhar moves across to defend but is caught on the pads. Loud appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Ali talks with his partner and then reviews. The TV umpire has a look at it and replays show that there's a slight inside edge there, while the impact was fine. Lucky him and unlucky Sri Lanka. He survives to fight another day.
Azhar Ali has been adjudged LBW but he has opted for the review. Only the impact may be outside off which can save him. Let's find out...
From over the wicket, it's turning in from around off, Azhar Ali stays back and flicks it on the leg side.
Azhar Ali walks in at No.3.

OUT! Sami Aslam departs! Is quite unfortunate, really. But Dilruwan strikes and this is just what Sri Lanka would have wanted. The offie comes from around the wicket and bowls a straighter one around off, it's sliding in and keeps really, really low. Strikes him low on the pads and there's an appeal made by the Lankans. Nigel Llong doesn't respond so the review is taken. Replays show that there is no bat involved and the impact is dead in line. So, Sami's innings comes to an end.
Review! Only an inside edge will save him. Sami Aslam could be in real trouble here.

Not out! Easy enough decision for the TV umpire. One of the easiest he'll ever have to make. Aslam sweeps it to square leg and takes off. Seeing the keeper run to the ball though, he comes back and plants his bat in the crease as there is a direct hit from Dickwella. He looks safe but the umpire just wants to make sure. It's taken upstairs and replays confirm that he's comfortably in.

Edged but it's not carried! Herath floats it outside off, Masood prods forward to play for the turn when there is none, so he edges it behind. However, it falls just short of the diving first slip fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another solid defensive shot off the front foot from Shan. Does so comfortably.
Tossed up outside off, meets the ball at its pitch with the full face of the bat.
Turning in from around off, Aslam bends the knee and sweeps it away behind square on the leg side and takes one.
Skips down the track and blocks it before the ball has a chance to turn.

7th Test fifty for Sami Aslam! Like his partner, he has looked really good since he's come out to bat. He goes back and taps it in front of point for a quick single. The wicket isn't easy to bat on and it's quite hot out there as well, so it's been a good knock.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sees the flight on this and uses his feet. Gets to the pitch and works it towards mid on. Hares across and completes the run with ease.
Full and fast around off, Shan with a solid front foot defense.
Straighter one from Dilruwan, blocked out with a straight bat.
Starts from over the wicket and flights it around off, Masood gets behind the line and defends.
Dilruwan Perera is into the attack now.
Loopy ball outside off, pushed square to point for one.
Leans ahead and across to push it into the covers. Wanted to find the gap but it went straight to the fielder.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Touch short in length outside off, Shan off the back foot taps it to point and crosses over.
Gets to the pitch of the delivery with the use of the feet and wrists it wide of mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, it's quite full so Masood plays this before it even turns. Flicks it through mid-wicket and picks up a run.
Full delivery close to off, driven by Aslam to the mid off fielder.
Switches to over the wicket, fires it full and wide outside off, doesn't bounce as much as Aslam shoulders his arms to it.
Brings out the sharp one and it's pretty sharp. Accurate and well-directed which forces Sami Aslam to duck and evade.
Comes from around the wicket, it's outside the line of off stump, pushed to the covers.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven past mid on for a couple of runs.
Length delivery seaming away from around off, Aslam with soft hands taps it down in front of covers.
Hint of turn on the final ball of the over, blocked again.
No spin on this occasion, so Masood walks a step across and defends it with a straight bat.
Tossed up again from Rangi, worked wide of the mid on fielder for a single.
Goes down the ground again, but on the other side. Eases this full ball down to mid off.
Floats it up on the stumps, driven to mid on for no run.
Spinning into the batsman from around off, hangs back and works it on the leg side.
Outside off on a similar length, tapped square on the off side with an open face. Dot ball and that's the end of the over from Pradeep.
Lands it on a good length very close to the off stump, Shan Masood stays rooted in his crease and defends it right under his nose.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
In the channel outside off, an easy leave to make for the batsman.
Swerving away from around off, just ahead of a length, tapped to the right of the bowler from within the crease.
Slanting across on a good length, Masood covers the line and lets it go past him.
Full outside off, eased back down the ground to mid off to end the over.
Goes on the back foot to this one and works it on the leg side with all the time in the world.

Muted shout for an lbw, nothing from the umpire though. A lot of loop from Rangana Herath, drops it full on off, turns in as Masood attempts the sweep. A shout results, shut down, however, because of the impact. Was outside off. A leg bye is taken.
Spinning in from a full length on off, once again it's flicked to the mid-wicket region. A single results this time.
Fullish around off, turned to mid-wicket again, this time by Aslam, but for no run.
A lot of flight to start things off from Herath, Masood leans ahead and works it through mid-wicket for an easy single.

Drinks taken. Good first hour for Pakistan. Aslam and Masood started slowly but have been more proactive as the day progressed. Masood was dropped on 51 and he will be eyeing a big one now. Sri Lanka have been sloppy in the field. There is no alarming turn and bounce on this track as the cracks haven't opened up that much. The visitors need to bowl probing lines and length to get success.
Back of a length outside off, Aslam camps back and defends it stoutly.
Surprise bouncer from Pradeep and it is well-directed. Aslam ducks under it.
Short delivery on middle and leg, sits up nicely for Aslam. He pulls it through in front of square leg for a couple. 100 up for Pakistan. It is met with a cheer from the crowd.
Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Aslam plants his front foot across to allow it through.
Fullish delivery, driven crisply to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, eased through covers for a single.
Change of ends for Pradeep.

Dropped! A tough chance goes down! Tossed up outside off, Masood prods forward to play for the spin but it isn't there on this occasion. Catches the outside edge of Masood's bat and flies towards Dickwella. It hits his pad and lobs towards Karunaratne at first slip. He is a bit blinded, bends to his right but fails to hold on. A single taken. The experienced campaigner almost struck in his first over of the day.
Fullish and wider outside off, kept out watchfully.
Turning into Aslam. Worked in front of square leg for a single.
Floated around off, played with the spin to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Sri Lanka turn to their go-to-man. Rangana Herath to roll his arm for the first time in the day.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Down the leg side, Masood misses out on his clip.

FOUR! Great way to bring up his 3rd Test fifty! He has looked in command and played a good knock. Fullish outside off, Masood drives it elegantly through extra cover and the ball whistles away to the fence. He raises his bat towards the dressing room. His teammates are up on their feet and applaud him.
Wrong one that goes down the wrong line. Down the leg side, Masood tries to flick it away but misses. Good take by Dickwella.
Floated outside off, eased to covers.
FOUR! Sublime! Tossed up outside off, Masood leans ahead confidently and creams it through extra cover to find the fence. Timing at its best!

This is good cricket from Masood. Fullish delivery around off, Shan plays it with soft hands towards mid off. Calls his partner through for a run and completes it with ease. There is a shy at the non-striker's end which misses. The back up fielder is not in place but Shan has run a long way. An extra run doesn't result.
FOUR! Well-controlled! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Masood swivels across and pulls it all along the ground past the diving backward square leg fielder. A boundary results.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Masood drives it crisply towards short cover who makes a sharp stop.
Fuller in length just outside off, Shan shuffles across and taps it back to the bowler.
Similar ball on off, timed sweetly to mid off.
Fullish delivery around off, slanting across Masood. He initially looks to commit himself to it but bails out at the last moment.
Nuwan Pradeep comes into the attack. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Googly outside off, turning in sharply. Aslam shuffles across to keep it out.
Sandakan stops in his delivery stride. He is struggling with his landing a bit.
Shortish around off, Masood cuts it with the spin through point to rotate strike.
Fullish delivery, knocked to mid on.

The wrong one again on a fuller length around off, Masood prods forward to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. A chirpy appeal for an LBW follows but the umpire stays put. The replays confirm there was an inside edge.
Floated delivery, pushed to covers off the front foot.
Bowls the wrong one again from the back of the hand. Spins in sharply and also stays low. Aslam perhaps reads it off the pitch. Adjusts well in the end to block it close to his pads.
Lakmal goes wider of the crease and bowls a full delivery outside off, Aslam moves across his stumps and clips it nicely to mid-wicket to pick up a single.
Fuller in length outside off, Sami prods forward to ease it to covers.
Lakmal switches his angle to around the wicket. Hurls it on a length outside off. It is angling in initially but after pitching straightens a bit. Sami makes a watchful leave.
Fullish in length in that off stump channel. Aslam lunges and defends it.
Length delivery on off, Shan transfers his weight on the front foot and taps it past the bowler towards mid off. Masood calls for the run straightaway and his partner responds. Good judgement!
Lakmal bowls this one with a scrambled seam around off and gets it to angle away. Masood doesn't fiddle with it.
Tossed up delivery, pushed with the spin to covers.
Slow through the air outside off, Aslam lunges forward in defense.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and blocks it.
Fullish delivery, knocked to mid off for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! First boundary of the day! Poor fielding again. Floated around off, Masood drives it crisply towards covers. The fielder puts in a swimming pool dive to his left and the ball goes through to the fence. The visitors should not let the intensity in the field drop.
Good leave! Length delivery outside off, angling in. Aslam knows where his off stump is and lets it go.
Lakmal comes around the wicket and gets it to angle in. Played with an open bat face to point.
In the zone outside off, left alone.

Runs after 24 deliveries! Sloppy work in the field as well! Full length delivery on middle and leg, Aslam works it to wide mid on and sets off immediately. Herath picks up the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. The back up fielder is not that attentive and has to dive but fails to stop it. Chandimal runs all the way from mid off to cut it off. Three extra runs conceded.
Similar length delivery, Sami keeps his bat inside the line and watches it through.
Fullish delivery on off, angling away. Aslam plants his front foot across and lets it go.

Terrific bowling from the youngster! Slips in the googly at a quicker pace on off, Masood rocks back to cut it, perhaps doesn't read the wrong one and is cramped for room. Somehow he manages to keep it out off the bottom half of the bat. Third consecutive maiden. Great stuff from the Sri Lankan bowlers.
Quicker and flatter one, Masood can't pick the gap once again as he punches it to covers.
Slower through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
A fraction short this time, spinning away. Shan rocks back and cuts it to the man at covers again. Dot balls continue and the pressure is mounting on the youngsters.
Fullish around off, Masood eases it to mid off.
Tossed up on off, driven crisply to the lone man at covers.
Fullish again outside off, a bit wider. Aslam strides to the pitch of the delivery and blocks it. Two consecutive maidens for Sri Lanka.
Lakmal changes his angle and runs in from around the wicket. Keeps it on a fuller length around off. Pushed off the front foot to short cover.
Fullish delivery on off, Aslam puts his head down and blocks it.
Good bowling! Lakmal hurls it on a length in the off stump channel, gets it to move away after pitching. Aslam makes a watchful leave.
Slanting across Sami. He points his bat skywards to leave it alone.
Fullish delivery around off, Aslam strides forward and defends it solidly.
Spin and bounce! On a fuller length around off, turning away sharply. Masood opts for the big sweep but gets beaten. The ball flies to the first slip fielder. Signs of things to come?
On middle, spinning away. Shan prods forward and keeps it out.
A bit quicker through the air on off, a bit of extra bounce. Masood covers the line and blocks it besides the pitch on the leg side.
Similar delivery, Masood lunges forward in defense.
Floated on off, Masood puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Half-tracker down the leg side, Masood goes for the pull but misses. Failed to capitalize on that.
Good length delivery on off, hits the deck and seams away. Sami adopts a circumspect approach again and does not flirt with it.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Aslam plants his front foot across to allow it through.
Fullish outside off this time, it is on a driving length but it does not engage Sami into a stroke.
On a length this time in the zone of apprehension. Aslam covers his stumps and makes a watchful leave. This is a good line and length to bowl.
Fractionally overpitched, angling away. Aslam strides ahead and strokes it through covers. Will get a couple for doing so.
Full length delivery on middle, Aslam pats it back to Lakmal. He picks it up and mimes a throw back to the batsman. Aggression from the quickie.
Fullish in line of the stumps, Aslam kneels and sweeps it all along the ground to deep square leg for a run.
Stays back to this one and keeps it out watchfully.

A stifled appeal for an LBW is turned down! Tossed up around leg stump, spinning in and staying a bit low. Masood looks to tuck it away but misses and the ball brushes his pad to go past the keeper. The Sri Lankans are interested but the umpire is not. It pitched outside leg stump.
Tossed up around off, Shan lunges forward in defense.
Fuller this time, defended solidly off the front foot.
Starts off with a shortish delivery on off, turning away. Masood cuts it towards short cover where the fielder dives to his right to stop it.
Lakshan Sandakan to bowl from the other end. He was really good yesterday.
Full length delivery again, a bit wider this time. Aslam doesn't fiddle with it.
Fullish delivery outside off, Aslam glides it to point.
Good length delivery, slanting across Sami and staying a touch low. He looks to guide it towards third man but gets a bottom edge to second slip.
That's a beauty! Touch fuller on off, swinging away. Aslam plants his front foot across and feels for it but is foxed completely.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Aslam waits for it and taps it with an open bat face to gully.
First run of the day! Length delivery on leg stump, Masood tucks it with soft hands to wide mid on for a single.

We are set to get underway. The players and the umpires make their way out to the middle. The Sri Lankan side is in a huddle and Chandimal is instilling inspiration in them. Sami Aslam and Shan Masood to continue their innings. The visitors to begin with pace. Suranga Lakmal to start off the proceedings. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 3 of the first Test match between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Abu Dhabi. The hosts' openers, Sami Aslam and Shan Masood, have replied well in response to the huge total posted by Sri Lanka. After the retirement of Misbah-ul-Haq and Younis Khan, it will be interesting to see how the senior men in Azhar Ali, Asad Shafiq and Sarfraz Ahmed take responsibility. There are no real demons on the track but it is on the slower and lower side. Spin will be expected to play a part and the visitors have a trio of them. Sandakan looked threatening yesterday with his variations and the tourists will bank on him. The experienced campaigners, Herath and Perera will also be expected to deliver. The third day is often considered the moving day of a Test match and the cracks might start to open up today. It will be a battle of wits and the character of both sides will be tested. Let's see who comes out on top.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Earlier in the day, Sri Lanka managed to post a very good total on the board, courtesy Chandimal's ton and his crucial partnerships with Dickwella first and then Perera. Pakistan too have started really well in order to cut down the deficit as they have not lost a wicket and already added 64 on the board. Join us for day 3 tomorrow. Till then, take care and good bye!

So, Pakistan have not only survived the last hour but have got off to a really good start. They still have a long way to go as they trail by another 355 runs. It won't be easy for the hosts. They will need all their batsmen to put their hands up if they are to surpass or get close to the score. For Sri Lanka, majority of the bowling will be done by spin tomorrow as they are the ones getting assistance from the track. They will try and take some early wickets to put the Pakistan side under pressure.
Spinning in from around off, the googly, Aslam moves across his sticks and defends it down by getting right behind the line. End of a testing final over from Lakshan Sandakan. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Spinning down the leg side, goes off Aslam's pads and down the leg side. The batsmen take two leg byes.

He almost had him! Sami Aslam did not pick up the wrong 'un at all. Sandakan drops it outside off and Aslam expects this to spin away from him. Only, it comes back in and almost takes the inside edge. Could have easily gone on to then hit the stumps. Close call.
Straighter one around off, takes the inside edge and raps him on the pads.
Floats it up outside off stump, pushed firmly to the man at mid off.
Huge appeal from Dickwella, probably because he didn't see the inside edge on it. Tossed up on middle and off, Aslam with an inside edge onto his pads on his attempted sweep.
Picks it off his pads and works it away on the leg side.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slight turn in from around off, Sami Aslam gets an inside edge onto his pads as he attempts to play at it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Spinning in from outside off, Aslam defends but is caught on the pads. Loud appeal but impact is well outside the line.

FOUR! That's a terrific shot! Sami Aslam is taking Rangana on here. Sees the massive amount of flight on that and takes a step out of his crease. Gets close to the pitch and lofts it over mid on for a one bounce boundary.
Flighted ball on off, Masood defends it with authority.
Wide enough for the batsman to play at it.
Mohammad Abbas is padded up. He might come in next as the nightwatchman if there is a wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, turns back in sharply. Aslam tries to cut but gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls besides the pitch.
Tosses it up but very full outside off. Aslam tries to drive but gets it off the bottom edge back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and hits it towards wide mid off. Lakmal there fumbles but only concedes a run.
Loopy ball on off, Aslam defends it solidly.
Drives it to mid on with the spin.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air on off, Aslam prods forward and blocks it.
Tosses it up on off, Aslam defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on off, Masood punches it back to the bowler.
Gives it air on off, Masood defends it off the front foot.
Shorter outside off, Masood has all the time in the world to cut it through point for a brace.
Googly, on middle which Masood is finding difficult to pick. He tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Driven down to long on for a run.

NOT OUT! That was very good work from Dickwella and it was beautifully bowled by Herath. He bowls a loopy ball outside off. Masood plays for the turn but there isn't any. Dickwella collects the ball and in a flash takes the bails off and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs and replays show that Masood had not lifted his legs at all. He survives.
The umpires have gone upstairs to check for a stumping against Masood. Dickwella is confident about it.
Floats it on off, Masood drives it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Masood tucks it towards short leg who is sharp there and makes a good stop.
Works it with the spin towards short leg.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery on middle, Aslam drives it down to long on for a run.
Rangana Herath is into the attack.

A googly by Sandakan outside off. Masood fails to read it. He plants his front foot ahead to defend but misses and is struck on the pad. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. The impact was an issue there.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Quicker through the air this time. Skids off the surface. Masood tries to cut but gets a bottom edge towards short third man.
Nails the sweep through square leg for a run.
Flighted ball on off, Aslam defends it off the front foot.
Floats it up outside off, Aslam lets it turn away and opts not to play at it.
Tosses it up outside off, Masood lets it be.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Masood says it is his turn now! He comes down the track as he sees a flighted ball on off and hits it over mid off for a boundary. Third boundary in the over. Also the fifty-run stand is up between the two.
Fires it on the pads, Aslam flicks it down to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Aslam on the charge here. He is nimble on his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
FOUR! He picks his spot well there! He knows there is nobody in the deep.  Aslam goes down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Lahiru Thirimanne does really well! Shorter in length on middle, Masood flicks it towards mid-wicket where Thirimanne dives and saves a few runs for his team.
Drags his length back outside off, Masood goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter this time but errs in line and bowls it down the leg side. Aslam flicks it through square leg for a run.
Gives it air on off, Sami lunges forward in defense.
Slower through the air on off, not a lot of turn. Aslam defends it off the front foot.
Lakshan Sandakan comes onto bowl. A lot will be expected of him.
Fires it on off, turning away. Masood covers the line and defends it.
Floats it up on off, Masood drives it back to the bowler who shows some aggression and throws it back to the keeper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gives it air on middle, Masood defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on leg stump. Aslam comes down the track and tries to go big but gets an inside edge past the short leg fielder for a run.
Angles it into the pads, Masood works it around the corner for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Masood defends it towards point for a run.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Aslam takes on the challenge to pull and does it well but to the man at deep backward square leg for a run.
Once again consistently bowling on the good length area around off. Aslam with authority defends it.
Angles it into the batsman. Masood shuffles across and works it around the corner for a run.
A better length outside off, Masood lunges forward and defends it towards covers.
Pradeep angles it into the pads of the batsman. Masood plants his front foot across and defends it.
Floats it up on off, Aslam defends it towards covers.
Quicker on the stumps, Sami camps back and blocks it.
Flatter on off, Aslam defends it stoutly.
Tosses it up on middle, Aslam goes down on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
BEAUTY! A great ball after the break, almost gets  a wicket. Perera angles it into the batsman and then gets it to spin away. Aslam goes to defend it but gets beaten.
Drinks are on the field!
Full and wide outside off, driven towards mid off. Masood will feel he's missed out, should have put it away. Was full and quite wide.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run taken.
Short of a good length around off, blocks it out off the back foot.
Angling back in on middle and off, Masood closes the face of the bat and works it in front of square leg. It's in the gap, so he immediately calls for the second. Good running, this.
Drops this into the vacant spaces in the cover region for a quick single.
Some room on offer outside off, on a length, Aslam opens the bat face and dabs it to gully.
Floated right up there, outside off, met with a straight bat.
Spinning away from around off, goes back and pushes it away into the off side.
Makes decent of his feet to get to the pitch, flicks it but again straight to short mid-wicket.
Darts this quicker again, on middle and off with only a hint of turn, Shan Masood presents a neat front foot defense.
Full and straight, played right back to Perera.
Quick and flat on middle and off, turned away straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
In the off stump channel, covers the line well and shoulders arms.
Good length ball outside off, Sami offers a solid punch but finds the man at point. Wanted the single, then rightly decided against it.
Short of a length outside off, defended down on the off side with soft hands.
Leans ahead a touch this time and pushes it just wide of the mid off fielder to steal a quick single. Nicely done.
Just back of a length again, straightening up after hitting the deck, Masood stands tall and meets it with a straight blade.
Back of a length outside the line of off stump, left alone.
Nuwan Pradeep back on to bowl.
Spinning away from around off, blocked off the front foot.
FOUR! Graceful shot! So sweetly done by Sami Aslam. Loopy and full outside off, the batsman leans into the shot easily and drives it past mid off to send it across the rope.
Full from Dilruwan, some decent air on it, defended.
Not much spin on this occasion, Sami moves across to get behind the line and blocks.

In the air... It's just short again! Perera darts it full, Aslam looks to clear mid on but doesn't exactly get underneath it. Chips it towards Herath positioned there but it falls just short of him. Crouched low to take it, wasn't there for the taking.
Tossed up on middle and off from around the wicket, Sami Aslam presses ahead and buries it into the track.
Stays back again and keeps it out safely to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Edged but just short! Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Masood has a poke at it and gets a healthy edge. It flies to third slip but falls just short of the diving fielder there. Close one, that almost carried.
Bit short around off but there isn't much bounce on it. Shan Masood tries to put bat on ball and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short of a good length outside off, punched off the back foot square through point for a couple of runs.
In the channel outside off, left alone by the batsman.
No ball! And a big one too, Suranga Lakmal's giving Wahab Riaz a real run for his money. He comes steaming in and lands it on a length outside off, it's left alone but the umpire signals no ball.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Poor line and Shan has taken full advantage of it. It's sliding down leg, Masood tickles it fine down the leg side past the keeper. The slip fielder chases it down and throws it back in. Three runs are taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quite straight in line, easily negotiated by Shan Masood.
Some flight on this occasion, it's pushed away square on the off side for nothing.
Tossed up on middle and leg, quite full in length, Masood presents a tight defensive shot.
Dilruwan Perera is on to roll his arm. Spin on rather quickly for Sri Lanka. Good move, the wicket does have a lot of bite. A slip and a short leg in place for him.
Dabs it away to point to end the over.
Just ahead of a length and outside off, Aslam is half-forward to defend but is beaten past the outside edge.
Angling back in on middle and leg, flicked off the pads on the leg side.
Around off on a good length, once again it's tapped to the covers for a quick run.
Fullish in length from Lakmal, Aslam drops it just wide of the cover fielder and steals a quick single.

Yes, no, yes, no. Confusion but no harm done in the end. Lakmal bowls it shorter in length. Aslam plays it with soft hands towards the leg side and wants a single. He sets off but is sent back by his partner. The fielder from mid-wicket comes running in and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Aslam is not happy with his partner as he gives him the stare. It would have been close had that hit, even Pakistan coach Mickey Arthur shakes his head looking at that. He is not impressed.
FOUR! Elegant! Fuller in length on off, Masood leans into it and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Brilliant by Mendis! Saves a boundary for his team. Shorter in length outside off, Aslam guides it to the right of point. Kusal there dives full stretch to his right and makes an excellent stop but can't stop the single.
Bowls it on a length on off, Aslam defends it towards covers.
Good length on off, Aslam defends it off the back foot.
Pradeep also comes around the wicket and bowls it outside off. Aslam lets it be.
Good length ball on off, Masood defends it with authority.
Lakmal bowls it fuller on middle, Masood flicks it through square leg but does not hit it that well. Has enough though to beat the diving fielder and collects two.
Errs in line and angles it down the leg side. Aslam just shuffles across and helps it down to fine leg to get off the mark with a run.
Flicks it down to fine leg with the angle for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, Masood pulls it along the ground to the man at square leg. That was nicely struck but straight to the fielder.
Lakmal comes around the wicket and lands it on a length on off. Masood defends it watchfully.
Back of a length on off, the batsman pushes it to mid off.
Short of a length outside off, Aslam off the back foot punches it to covers.
Just ahead of a length on off, angling away. Aslam lunges forward in defense.
Fuller in length on off, Masood plays it towards the cover region for a quick single.
Good length outside off, Masood is not interested in playing at it.
Comes running in and lands it on a length around off. A very good line and length to bowl. Masood defends it off the front foot.
Nuwan Pradeep will bowl from the other end.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Aslam opts not to play at it.
Lands it on middle, Masood shuffles across and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Good length outside off, wanting Masood to go after it but he resists and lets it through.

That was beautifully timed! Lakmal bowls it on middle, Masood off the back foot punches it through mid-wicket and completes a run. They take off for a second. Herath gives it a chase, slides, picks the ball up and fires a throw at the striker's end but the batsman has made his ground.
Lands it on a length on off, Masood defends it off the back foot.

Starts off with a length ball on middle, it comes slow off the wicket. Masood tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards mid off. He wanted a run but is sent back by his partner. He will be eager to get off the mark here.
